scripts.dev: bun run package:build && bun run --cwd apps/example dev
scripts.build: bun run package:build && bun run --cwd apps/example build
scripts.check: bun run package:check && bun run package:build && bun run --cwd apps/example typecheck
scripts.package:pack: bun run package:build && npm pack --workspace pagiera --ignore-scripts
scripts.templates:check: bun run templates/scripts/validate.ts && bun run templates/scripts/audit-responsive.ts
